full_page.content:
1935, November
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 66 Cont.
Nov. 6 Camille Pratt - 67 - stomach cancer feared asks for prayers. Mrs. Barbara Quinkert - 5 7 - something like Asthma - poisoned system.
Mrs. Ida Rousseau - 55 - threatened colon ..... has had 13 already. Hilda Martin - 40 - of Monroe - cataract - fears operation. Mother M. Annocita - operation To-day 6th
Page 67 Nov. 6 Thos & Cath. Connolly - Elderly people. Mrs. was to have operation but came out OK without it. Now having trouble again - Husband had a stroke recently.
Byron Miller - 24 - T.B. hermoraging - fears operation. Mrs. Frances Thiefels - 77 - Rev.
Mrs. E. C. Button - 44 - losing sight - kidney trouble, weak. Drs. at sea at to what real cause may be. Own husband a doctor and non Catholic. ...
Page 68 Nov. 13 Alice Bahouth - 11 - ostemalitis - leg in cast now two mos. - 2 mo. more.
Mrs. Clara LaLanale - 43 - one kidney gone, fears operation on other. George Stepniak - 41 - husband , father, step-father, losing faith & respect for wife and children & step children.
Albert Palmera - 12 of Pittsburgh - struck on side of eye by a hard pear three years ago. Little by little sight goes ... Comes To-day on way back home and is enrolled 50¢
Wm. Dueweke .... trying to pay honest debts.
Winifred Gentner - (20) here To-day - (see Nov. 6) quite OK but asks prayers for just settlement of accident a year ago.
